events.title: Demo v0.9.2: Controller Support, Better Handling & Fairer Chases
events.summary: Thank you for playing! Since the demo went live on Oct 8, players on Bilibili, RedNote and Steam have sent a lot of detailed feedback. This update is built almost entirely from it.🆕 NewXbox and PlayStation controller support. On-screen prompts switch automatically between keyboard keys and controller buttons. The View/Create button resets your car.Community page in the main menu, with links to Discord, QQ group, Bilibili, RedNote, YouTube, X, Instagram, Steam discussions.🔧 ImprovedHandling: all
